title: Couples Discount
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this Valentine's Day episode, the office staff attempt to take advantage of couples discounts by pairing off with fake partners, leading to humorous and tense situations. Pam and Jim enjoy being together in the same city and plan a romantic lunch, while Erin struggles with her intention to break up with Andy, who returns early from a boat trip. Dwight impersonates Andy at work, causing complications including a lost sales contract. Erin ultimately breaks up with Andy due to his prolonged absence and lack of communication. Meanwhile, a fire in the warehouse causes significant damage, and the office grapples with the aftermath.

main_threads.thread: The office employees' attempts to use fake couples to get Valentine's Day discounts lead to conflicts and comedic moments, including Clark refusing to continue pretending to be Nellie's boyfriend and Oscar and Darryl being denied a discount for being two men.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Or the mini mall. They have all these Valentine Day deals. You can get 20% off if you come in with your husband or your boyfriend.
Nellie: Everyone, it is our last day here with no manager. I say we go to the mini mall. Clark, you will be my fake boyfriend so I can get the discount.
Clark: Oh, you guys think this is funny? You know what? No more discount. Excuse me. Full price. We're not together.
Nellie: Turns out, I can't even be in a pretend relationship.
Nail manager: No. No discount for two men. Two men are not a couple.
Darryl: Oh, it works. Him and me, all right, we are crazy in love.

main_threads.thread: Erin plans to break up with Andy due to his long absence, and despite Andy's early return and attempts to reconnect, Erin ultimately ends their relationship. Andy also faces challenges at work due to Dwight's actions during his absence.

evidence.snippet: Erin: I really wanna have fun today because tomorrow is going to be a nightmare. Andy's coming back from his stupid, dumb boat trip.
Pete: Erin says she's gonna break up with Andy, but I'm not sure.
Erin (obviously avoiding Andy's embrace): Yes. Welcome back, buddy.

Phyllis (as everyone returns to the office): Ah, geez. My nails aren't dry yet. I don't think I can work for at least a couple hours.
Andy: Well, well, well, look who it is.
Phy...
Erin: I don't love you anymore.
Erin (bursts into Andy's office): We're breaking up. And just so you know, I was worried that you were dead. You were gone for three months.

main_threads.thread: A fire in the warehouse destroys Pam's mural and the warehouse itself, leading to the firing of a warehouse employee and concern among the office staff about the consequences.

evidence.snippet: Andy: There was a fire in the warehouse?
